# Guide discovery links

Local browser captures of the actual GuidesHub, MarketingShell and ArabicShell components with repository Tailwind styles. English and Arabic hubs are shown at1440x1000 and390x1000. Both mobile documents measured390px wide with no horizontal overflow; Arabic rendered RTL. Reciprocal language links are visible at both sizes.

The isolated Vite harness supplies only the public GitHub repository URL in place of environment-dependent link configuration. No product backend, authentication or production data was used. These captures verify local layout, not a deployed release or Google indexing. Browser console reported only a missing harness favicon.

Focused server-rendered tests additionally verify Arabic footer discovery, configured-default-language links, non-default language/version preservation and explicit authored cross-language links. No interaction recording is needed for these ordinary anchors.
